title: Bleach
description: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: After becoming a Shinigami, Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to help Rukia Kuchiki with her work as the local Shinigami of Karakura Town.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: When a Hollowfied Sora Inoue attacks his younger sister, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki set out to save her.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: When Yasutora Sado receives a parakeet that contains the Soul of a young boy, it is up to Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki to protect him from the Hollow that is after them.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Rukia Kuchiki and Yasutora Sado team up to take on the Hollow Shrieker.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: At Rukia Kuchiki's behest, Ichigo Kurosaki puts an artificial soul in his body to take care of it and not arouse suspicion while he carries out his Substitute Shinigami duties, but the artificial soul has its own agenda.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes friends with the Modified Soul, Kon, and puts him into a plushie.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Two Shinigami, 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, arrive in the Human World to take Rukia Kuchiki back to the Soul Society.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki loses his Shinigami powers and Rukia Kuchiki is taken back to Soul Society.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his training with Kisuke Urahara to regain his Shinigami powers and save Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Kisuke Urahara helps Ichigo Kurosaki regain his Shinigami powers.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: After completing their training, Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends depart to Soul Society to rescue Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter Soul Society.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are forced to find another way into Seireitei due to 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru's intervention.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the household of the Shiba Clan.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: As Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends begin their preparations to get into the Seireitei, the Gotei 13 captains assemble for a meeting.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the Seireitei.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are scattered throughout the Seireitei, where they encounter new enemies.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki completes his battle with 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame while his friends continue to progress through the Seireitei.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: Ganju Shiba wins his battle against 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa while Uryū Ishida begins his own.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Uryū Ishida defeats 7th Division 4th Seat Jirōbō Ikkanzaka while Ichigo Kurosaki and Ganju Shiba encounter 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada, who personally knows Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: Having been led to the base of Senzaikyū, Ichigo Kurosaki begins his rematch with 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai conclude their rematch.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai remembers his past with Rukia Kuchiki and begs Ichigo Kurosaki to save her in his stead.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: In the Human World, Yuzu Kurosaki finds a cat named Raku and is drawn into an adventure with Don Kanonji and his Karakura-Raizer Team.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: As the Gotei 13 reacts to 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai's defeat, Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto declares war against the Ryoka.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: While the Gotei 13 deals with the death of 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen, Ichigo Kurosaki and his group attempt to enter Senzaikyū once again.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: Yasutora Sado battles with 8th Division captain, Shunsui Kyōraku.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: As the high-ranking members of the Gotei 13 continue to react to 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen's murder, Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: After learning to access the power of Zangetsu in addition to his own, Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: While 11th Division Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi reminisces about her history with her captain, Kenpachi Zaraki, Ganju Shiba and 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada reach Rukia Kuchiki's cell in Senzaikyū.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 41
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki arrives at the White Tower and reunites with Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: Yoruichi Shihōin saves Ichigo Kurosaki and decides to help him attain Bankai.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 43
episodes_data.description: Uryū Ishida and Orihime Inoue are confronted by 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 44
episodes_data.description: Uryū Ishida removes his Sanrei Glove to defeat 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 45
episodes_data.description: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his Bankai Training.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 46
episodes_data.description: 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori recalls her past at the Shin'ō Academy.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 47
episodes_data.description: As Ichigo Kurosaki continues his Bankai Training, 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori confronts 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya over the contents of the letter left by her captain, Sōsuke Aizen.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 48
episodes_data.description: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 49
episodes_data.description: Rukia Kuchiki recalls her past with Kaien Shiba.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 50
episodes_data.description: The Karakura Superheroes come together once more and fight a Hollow.

episodes_data.title: Bleach Season 1 Episode 51
episodes_data.description: As the day of Rukia Kuchiki's execution arrives, various groups around the Seireitei move out and clash with one another.
